edbDesc: The penetration of a permeate (such as a liquid, gas, or vapour) through a solid. The permeate always migrates to the lower concentration in three steps: 1. Sorption (at the interface); 2. Diffusion (through the solid); 3. Desorption (the adsorbate leaves the solid as a gas).
title: Permeation
pickWhy: Gas or liquid seeping through a solid is diffusion through it; the deck's Diffusion card (Graham) covers it.
